sentences.en: He is not much of a companion for his wife.
sentences.zh: 他和他的妻子不太般配。

sentences.en: God is my leader, and my sword is my companion.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，上帝是我的领路人，而我的剑则是我的同伴。

sentences.en: My companion’s nerves seemed to be stronger than mine.
sentences.zh: 我同伴的心理素质似乎比我好得多。

senses.zh: 同伴，同事，共事者，伴侣，成对物品之一，(船的)甲板间扶梯(或扶梯的顶篷)

mnemonic: 联想记忆：compani（看作company，陪伴）+on→同伴
